# Real Binance USDⓈ-M quarterlies across three rolls (2024-09-19, 2024-12-19, 2025-03-20)

Fetched 2026-09-30 from data.binance.vision and fapi.binance.com with qkt itself:

```
qkt fetch BINANCE_UM:BTCUSDT --catalog
qkt fetch BINANCE_UM:BTCUSDT --rolls   # 8d@08:00 policy; measured 13 of 24 front rolls, 2023-09 to 2026-09
qkt fetch BINANCE_UM:BTCUSDT_240927 --tf 1h --from 2024-09-10 --to 2024-09-20
qkt fetch BINANCE_UM:BTCUSDT_241227 --tf 1h --from 2024-09-18 --to 2024-12-20
qkt fetch BINANCE_UM:BTCUSDT_250328 --tf 1h --from 2024-12-18 --to 2025-03-21
qkt fetch BINANCE_UM:BTCUSDT_250627 --tf 1h --from 2025-03-19 --to 2025-04-11
```

The catalog and roll history are trimmed to `BTCUSDT_240628` .. `BTCUSDT_250627` and the four rolls
between them, so the stream is anchored at the 2024-06-20 roll (the June and September 2024 roll
prices are the same as in `../btcusdt-rolls`). Each contract's 1h bars cover its front stretch of
2024-09-10 .. 2025-04-11 plus a day either side. SHA-256:
